brief: Compares a baseline graph with several variations and ranks them by what changed: nodes, edges, density, cycles and bottlenecks.
detail: Built by stzGraph.CompareWithManyQR(..., :stzGraphComparison) or directly. It runs the comparison once when built and answers from the stored rows: Summary for a text report, MostImpactful and LeastImpactful, ByMetric to sort, Recommend for a suggestion, ToStzTable for a table. The cycle questions (WithCycles, WithoutCycles) and the acyclic bonus of Recommend do not work today; see their warnings.
receiver: g1 = new stzGraph("g1"); g1.AddNode("a"); g1.AddNode("b"); g1.Connect("a", "b"); o1 = new stzGraphComparison(g1, [ g1 ])
